# Rebecca Node 1.6.0

Rebecca Node 1.6.0 applies user changes in batches, makes Xray restarts safe, and reports native service diagnostics. It keeps node operations aligned with Rebecca 1.6.0, which no longer offers node builds older than this release.

## Highlights

- 📦 **Batched user updates** — apply many user changes in one call and receive a result for each user. Rebecca falls back to per-user updates for nodes without this capability.
- 🔁 **Restart-safe Xray** — a restart waits for the previous Xray process to exit before starting a new one, and Xray API connections give up after a short deadline instead of blocking for a minute.
- 🩺 **Runtime diagnostics** — native service and runtime health details are reported to the panel for per-node troubleshooting.
- 🔧 **Live user stability** — inbound VLESS flow is inherited during live user updates, sync deadlocks are prevented, and healthy runtimes are kept running.

## Reliability and compatibility

- The node continues to run the configured official Xray binary without a patched core.
- Existing node identity, certificates, and managed runtime settings are retained on upgrade.
- Healthy runtimes are not replaced during reconciliation.

## Upgrade notes

> Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together. Once a node is on 1.6.0, the panel will not install older node builds. Expect a short restart of the Xray process on the node during the upgrade.
